title: CAD IR Phase 14 — Process-aware manufacturing rules
summary: Step-by-step implementation plan to add two process-specific manufacturing validation rules (laser-cut min hole, min slot) to the CAD IR validator.
notes: Phased implementation plan / build guide with embedded code and tests. Not an ADR (no Decision/Consequences trade-off section), not a PRD (no user stories or business requirements), not a SPEC (no API/schema contract — it's a procedural plan to add rules whose contracts are inline code). Classified as DOC (procedural guide). Some SPEC-like signal from rule definitions (mfg.laser-cut-min-hole, mfg.laser-cut-min-slot) and from manufacturingTier signature change, but the document's primary mode is task-by-task implementation steps.
